# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

**Prerequisite:** `map` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

Run `firecrawl map --help` for the full option list (sitemap handling, subdomains, etc.).

**Done when:** the URL list is saved under `.firecrawl/` and you have selected the URLs to scrape or crawl next.

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)
- [firecrawl-build-search](https://github.com/firecrawl/skills/tree/main/skills/build/firecrawl-build-search) — building URL discovery into an app instead of running it here

The sidebar of the Hono docs lists 26 pages under `/docs/middleware/builtin/`. I took the page list from the live site. The one-line descriptions come from what I know of Hono's docs, and I didn't open each page to check them.

| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| [basic-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/basic-auth) | Protects routes with HTTP Basic authentication, using fixed credentials, multiple users, or a custom verify function. |
| [bearer-auth](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/bearer-auth) | Requires a valid Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. |
| [body-limit](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/body-limit) | Rejects requests whose body is larger than a size you set. |
| [cache](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cache) | Caches responses using the Web Standard Cache API (Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and similar). |
| [combine](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/combine) | Merges several middleware into one, with `some`, `every`, and `except` helpers for conditional composition. |
| [compress](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/compress) | Compresses response bodies with gzip or deflate. |
| [context-storage](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/context-storage) | Stores the request `Context` in `AsyncLocalStorage`, so `getContext()` works anywhere in the call stack. |
| [cors](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/cors) | Handles Cross-Origin Resource Sharing: allowed origins, methods, headers, and preflight requests. |
| [csrf](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/csrf) | Guards against CSRF attacks by checking the `Origin` header and content type on form-style requests. |
| [etag](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/etag) | Adds `ETag` headers to responses so clients can make conditional requests. |
| [ip-restriction](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/ip-restriction) | Allows or blocks requests by client IP address or CIDR range. |
| [jsx-renderer](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jsx-renderer) | Sets up JSX layouts for `c.render()`, with support for streaming and nested layouts. |
| [jwk](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwk) | Verifies JWTs against a JSON Web Key Set (JWKS), either static keys or a remote URI. |
| [jwt](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/jwt) | Verifies JSON Web Tokens from the header or a cookie, using a secret or key you provide. |
| [logger](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/logger) | Logs each request's method, path, status, and elapsed time. |
| [language](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/language) | Detects the client's preferred language from the query string, cookie, or `Accept-Language` header. |
| [method-not-allowed](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-not-allowed) | Returns a 405 with an `Allow` header when a path exists but not for the requested HTTP method. |
| [method-override](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/method-override) | Lets a POST request act as PUT, DELETE, or similar, using a form field, header, or query parameter. |
| [mount](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/mount) | Mounts a non-Hono application (any fetch-style handler) under a path prefix. |
| [pretty-json](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/pretty-json) | Pretty-prints JSON responses when you add `?pretty` to the URL. |
| [request-id](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/request-id) | Generates a unique request ID, or reuses one from a header, and exposes it on the context and response. |
| [secure-headers](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/secure-headers) | Sets security headers such as CSP, HSTS, `X-Frame-Options`, and `X-Content-Type-Options`. |
| [timeout](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timeout) | Aborts a request with a timeout error if the handler takes too long. |
| [timing](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/timing) | Adds `Server-Timing` headers so you can see backend timings in browser dev tools. |
| [trailing-slash](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/trailing-slash) | Redirects URLs to add or remove a trailing slash, so `/path` and `/path/` resolve consistently. |

The sidebar also links to the [third-party middleware](https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/third-party) page, but that page is outside the `builtin` section.
